history.name: The timeline of what was presented, when
history.description: `ledger release list` prints every release in order with the date it was presented, the name of the moment it stood for, and how many entries moved in it — the history of the product at the level of the occasions it was shown, with the release still in progress marked as such.
history.dev_notes: list() in release.mjs; the entry count is features touched at that version.
